answer: Concretely, price identity before it can speak. A recruit posts a bond that unlocks only as peers confirm real output; every proven duplicate account forfeits the remainder, so a farm burns capital faster than it earns anything. In effect the tundra of free entry disappears, the velvet of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the cedar case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. The result is that sybils must outspend the network they are attacking, indefinitely.
